title: Ephesians Chapter 4 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ephesians chapter 4 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ephesians Chapter 4 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ephesians Chapter 4.

questions.question: In Ephesians 4, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: One Lord, one faith, one baptism
I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you
questions.correctAnswer: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:1 begins with the Apostle Paul stating, 'I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you...'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:2, how should one walk?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:2 instructs to walk 'With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love.'

questions.question: What are we to endeavour to keep according to Ephesians 4:3?
options: The unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace
questions.correctAnswer: The unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:3 says, 'Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.'

questions.question: How many bodies are mentioned in Ephesians 4:4?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:4 states, 'There is one body, and one Spirit...'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:5, how many baptisms are there?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:5 says, 'One Lord, one faith, one baptism,'

questions.question: Who is described as 'above all, and through all, and in you all' in Ephesians 4:6?
options: One God and Father of all
questions.correctAnswer: One God and Father of all
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:6 states, 'One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.'

questions.question: What is given to every one of us according to Ephesians 4:7?
options: Grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:7 says, 'But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:8, what did He do when He ascended up on high?
options: He led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men
questions.correctAnswer: He led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:8 states, 'When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.'

questions.question: What did He do before He ascended, as stated in Ephesians 4:9?
options: He descended first into the lower parts of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: He descended first into the lower parts of the earth
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:9 says, 'Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?'

questions.question: Who is described as the one that descended and also ascended far above all heavens in Ephesians 4:10?
options: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens
questions.correctAnswer: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:10 states, 'He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:11, which of the following is NOT listed as a gift given by Christ?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:11 lists 'apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;' but does not mention kings.

questions.question: Ephesians 4:1 states that Paul is a prisoner of the Lord.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:1 says, 'I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you...'.

questions.question: Ephesians 4:5 mentions 'one Lord, one faith, one baptism.'
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:5 clearly states, 'One Lord, one faith, one baptism,'

questions.question: Ephesians 4:4 says there are many hopes of your calling.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:4 states, 'There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;' so it does not say many hopes.

questions.question: Ephesians 4:11 says Christ gave some apostles, kings, evangelists, pastors and teachers.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:11 lists apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers, but does not mention kings.

medium.title: Ephesians Chapter 4 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ephesians Chapter 4 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the gifts given to the church according to Ephesians 4:12?
options: For the perfecting of the saints
For the destruction of the body of Christ
For the increase of individual power
questions.correctAnswer: For the perfecting of the saints
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:12 states that the gifts are given for the perfecting of the saints, which emphasizes the role of ministry in building up the church.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:13 promise will happen if the saints are perfected as stated in Ephesians 4:12?
options: They will come in the unity of the faith
They will be free from all struggles
They will be recognized by all
questions.correctAnswer: They will come in the unity of the faith
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:13 indicates that the goal of perfecting the saints is to achieve unity in faith and knowledge of Christ.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:14, what should believers no longer be like?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:14 warns believers against being like children who are easily swayed by false teachings.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:15 suggest is necessary for growth in Christ?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:15 emphasizes that growth into Christ requires both truth and love in our interactions.

questions.question: What is the function of the body of Christ as described in Ephesians 4:16?
options: To make increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love
questions.correctAnswer: To make increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:16 describes the body of Christ as working together to build itself up in love.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:17, how should believers not walk?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:17 instructs believers to avoid walking like Gentiles, who are characterized by vanity of mind.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:18 say about those who are alienated from the life of God?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:18 highlights that those alienated from God suffer from darkened understanding due to the blindness of their hearts.

questions.question: What behavior is described in Ephesians 4:19 as a result of past feeling?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:19 explains that those who are past feeling have surrendered to lasciviousness and uncleanness.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:20 imply about the knowledge of Christ?
options: Ye have not so learned Christ
It is irrelevant to daily life
It is only for the wise
It is subject to personal interpretation
questions.correctAnswer: Ye have not so learned Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:20 asserts that true learning of Christ does not align with the corrupt behaviors described earlier.

questions.question: What must believers do according to Ephesians 4:22?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:22 instructs believers to discard the old selves that are corrupt and deceitful.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:5 affirm about the Christian faith?
options: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism
There are many paths to God
Each person has their own truth
questions.correctAnswer: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:5 establishes the foundational unity of the Christian faith with the affirmation of one Lord and one faith.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:3 encourage believers to do?
options: Endeavour to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace
questions.correctAnswer: Endeavour to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:3 emphasizes the importance of striving for unity among believers in the spirit of peace.

questions.question: Is it true that Ephesians 4 emphasizes the need for unity among believers?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4 repeatedly stresses the importance of unity among believers, particularly in verses 3 and 13.

questions.question: Is it false that believers are encouraged to walk in the same way as Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:17 explicitly instructs believers not to walk as Gentiles do, highlighting a contrast in lifestyle.

questions.question: Is it false that the body of Christ is meant to operate independently without connection to one another?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:16 describes the body of Christ as being fitly joined together, indicating interdependence.

hard.title: Ephesians Chapter 4 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ephesians Chapter 4.

questions.question: What should one be renewed in according to Ephesians 4:23?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:23 states 'And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;' which emphasizes the importance of mental and spiritual renewal.

questions.question: Which new creation is mentioned in Ephesians 4:24?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:24 states 'And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.'

questions.question: According to Ephesians 4:25, what should we put away?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:25 instructs 'Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.'

questions.question: What does Ephesians 4:26 say about anger?
options: Be ye angry, and sin not
questions.correctAnswer: Be ye angry, and sin not
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:26 states 'Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:' highlighting a distinction between feeling anger and acting upon it sinfully.

questions.question: What should one not give place to, according to Ephesians 4:27?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:27 warns 'Neither give place to the devil,' indicating the need to resist evil influences.

questions.question: What should those who stole do according to Ephesians 4:28?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:28 instructs 'Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'kardia' in Ephesians 4:32 mean?
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'kardia' translates to 'heart,' which is central to a person's emotions and moral character, as reflected in Ephesians 4:32.

questions.question: What literary device is employed in Ephesians 4:32 where kindness and forgiveness are emphasized?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:32 uses parallelism by presenting 'kind' and 'forgiving' as key virtues that are closely related, enhancing the message of mutual support.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of unity found in Ephesians 4:3?
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:2 encourages unity by stating, 'Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.' This echoes the unity theme in Ephesians 4:3.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage fulfills the concept of the 'new man' in Ephesians 4:24?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:17 states, 'Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new,' which parallels the idea of the 'new man' in Ephesians 4:24.

questions.question: What comes immediately before Ephesians 4:30?
options: Let all bitterness be put away
Let him that stole steal no more
Be ye angry, and sin not
And grieve not the holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: Let all bitterness be put away
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:31, which comes immediately before Ephesians 4:30, instructs to 'Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:'

questions.question: What comes immediately after Ephesians 4:29?
options: Let all bitterness be put away
And grieve not the holy Spirit
Let him that stole steal no more
Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth
questions.correctAnswer: And grieve not the holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:30, which follows Ephesians 4:29, states 'And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.'

questions.question: The instruction to 'be ye kind one to another' is supported by which Old Testament principle?
questions.explanation: This principle found in Leviticus 19:18 aligns with Ephesians 4:32's call to be kind and forgiving, illustrating continuity in God's expectations for human relationships.

questions.question: The call to forgive one another in Ephesians 4:32 reflects what aspect of God's character?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:32 emphasizes kindness and forgiveness, mirroring God's forgiveness toward humanity, highlighting His character as loving and merciful.

questions.question: The instruction to not let the sun go down on your wrath implies that anger should be held onto.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:26 states 'Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:' indicating that anger should be resolved quickly and not retained.

theological.title: Ephesians Chapter 4 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ephesians Chapter 4 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 4:1 teach about sanctification?
options: Believers are called to live in a manner worthy of their divine calling
Sanctification is a one-time event completed at conversion
Sanctification is solely about external observance of laws
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are called to live in a manner worthy of their divine calling
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:1 exhorts believers to 'walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,' indicating sanctification as a continuous, worthy lifestyle in response to God's calling.

questions.question: What doctrine about the unity of the Church does Ephesians 4:4 teach?
options: There is one body, one Spirit, one hope, emphasizing ecclesiastical unity
The Church consists of many independent bodies without unity
Unity is based on cultural and ethnic similarities
Unity is optional and secondary to individual freedom
questions.correctAnswer: There is one body, one Spirit, one hope, emphasizing ecclesiastical unity
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:4 states 'There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling,' teaching the essential doctrinal unity of the Church in Christ.

questions.question: What doctrine about spiritual gifts does Ephesians 4:11 teach?
options: Christ has given various offices such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers for Church edification
Spiritual gifts are no longer operative after the apostolic age
Only apostles and prophets are valid gifts in the Church
Spiritual gifts are personal and not given for the common good
questions.correctAnswer: Christ has given various offices such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers for Church edification
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:11 clearly teaches that Christ gave these specific roles to equip the saints and build up the body of Christ.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ephesians 4:6 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:6 describes God as 'above all, and through all, and in you all,' demonstrating His sovereign rule over all things.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is exemplified in Ephesians 4:2 through the Christian's conduct?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:2 calls for 'longsuffering, forbearing one another in love,' reflecting the divine attribute of longsuffering manifested in believers.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 4:8–10 connect to the Old Testament theme of the Messiah’s exaltation?
options: It fulfills Psalm 68's depiction of Christ ascending and giving gifts
It contradicts Old Testament expectations by denying Christ’s exaltation
It ignores Old Testament references entirely
It teaches that Christ’s exaltation is only metaphorical
questions.correctAnswer: It fulfills Psalm 68's depiction of Christ ascending and giving gifts
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:8 quotes Psalm 68:18, connecting Christ’s ascension and gift-giving to messianic fulfillment.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does Ephesians 4:22-24 make regarding the believer’s transformation?
options: It parallels the new creation motif from Genesis 1 and 2
It denies any new creation in Christ
It teaches that transformation is purely external conformity
It connects only to Mosaic law without reference to Christ
questions.correctAnswer: It parallels the new creation motif from Genesis 1 and 2
questions.explanation: The call to 'put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness' (Eph 4:24) echoes the theme of new creation as in Genesis.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Ephesians 4:25 and Ephesians 4:32 teach about Christian community?
options: Truthful speech and forgiving kindness are essential for community unity
Community is maintained by strict legalism and judgment
Indifference to others is a mark of Christian maturity
questions.correctAnswer: Truthful speech and forgiving kindness are essential for community unity
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:25 commands speaking truth because 'we are members one of another,' and 4:32 calls for kindness and forgiveness, both foundational for Christian fellowship.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Ephesians 4:14 and Ephesians 4:15 teach about Christian maturity?
options: Maturity involves rejecting false doctrine and growing in truth and love toward Christ
Maturity is achieved by intellectual ascendancy alone
Maturity means isolation from other believers
Maturity requires complete doctrinal uniformity before love
questions.correctAnswer: Maturity involves rejecting false doctrine and growing in truth and love toward Christ
questions.explanation: Verses 14 and 15 emphasize no longer being 'carried about with every wind of doctrine' but 'speaking the truth in love' to grow into Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Ephesians 4:28 and Ephesians 4:29 teach about Christian ethical speech and work?
options: Believers must work honestly and use edifying speech to minister grace
Speech and work are unrelated to Christian ethics
Work is unimportant, but speech must be controlled
Ethics focus only on internal attitudes, not external behavior
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must work honestly and use edifying speech to minister grace
questions.explanation: Verse 28 advocates honest labor to help others, while verse 29 commands speech that edifies and ministers grace.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Ephesians 4:17-19 teaches that Gentiles are irredeemably corrupt. What does the passage actually teach?
options: It describes Gentiles' former state but contrasts it with the new life in Christ for believers
It teaches that Gentiles can never be saved
It advocates hatred and exclusion of Gentiles
It denies any moral responsibility for Gentiles
questions.correctAnswer: It describes Gentiles' former state but contrasts it with the new life in Christ for believers
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:17-19 depicts the previous darkened understanding of Gentiles, preparing for the call to put off the old man and put on the new (v.22-24).

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 4:16 teach about the Church's growth and unity?
options: The Church grows through the effective working of every part in love, joined as one body under Christ
The Church is a loose association without interdependence
Growth is individualistic and unrelated to unity
Unity is secondary to personal gifts
questions.correctAnswer: The Church grows through the effective working of every part in love, joined as one body under Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:16 portrays the body of Christ as joined together, with each joint supplying, leading to edification in love.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is emphasized by the sealing of believers mentioned in Ephesians 4:30?
questions.explanation: The sealing by the Holy Spirit 'unto the day of redemption' (Eph 4:30) reveals God's faithfulness to preserve and complete salvation.

questions.question: What doctrine about human sin and renewal is taught in Ephesians 4:22-24?
options: Believers must put off the old corrupt self and be renewed in the spirit of their mind, putting on the new man created in righteousness
Sin is only external and does not affect the mind
Renewal is optional and unrelated to righteousness
Old sinful nature remains unchanged after conversion
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must put off the old corrupt self and be renewed in the spirit of their mind, putting on the new man created in righteousness
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:22-24 teaches the necessity of putting off the old man and being renewed to live righteously and holy before God.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 4:7 demonstrate the doctrine of grace in the economy of salvation?
options: Grace is given to each believer according to the measure of Christ's gift
Grace is only given to a select few arbitrarily
Grace is earned by works and merit
Grace is a general concept without specific application
questions.correctAnswer: Grace is given to each believer according to the measure of Christ's gift
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:7 states that grace is given 'according to the measure of the gift of Christ,' affirming grace as a sovereign gift from Christ to believers.
